verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies a per-candidate record: the API lets you create candidates, attach ratings to a candidate, and fetch a candidate's latest offer. Nothing describes a unified profile view that combines these with other data. Missing for 10: documentation of a single unified candidate profile, resume/CV storage on the record, email thread history, interview feedback scorecards beyond simple ratings, a per-candidate activity timeline, GDPR/consent status tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
